note: cluster-level candidate scorer (docs/30 §3): logistic regression on the 10 layout features of the experiment plus |ln(r/r_h)| (LOSO selection acc 82.5 % vs 81.3 % without it), standardised with mean/std, fitted on exp candidates (box margin 10 %, 51479 range clusters of 13286 worker boxes, 19 segments). Features are computed per range cluster (single linkage link_m) of the in-box radar points; r_h = fx * height_m / box_h_px. p = sigmoid(coef . (x - mean) / std + intercept).
